gold: Primary signet-ring cell carcinoma of the bladder

selector.rationale: The vignette describes a polypoidal mass with mucinous and signet-ring cell components, which aligns with the characteristics of urinary bladder adenocarcinoma, a broader category that encompasses various subtypes including signet-ring cell and mucinous adenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Secondary adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: No clear evidence of a primary adenocarcinoma elsewhere in the body

rejected.label: Mucinous Adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: While mucinous components are present, the diagnosis is more accurately described by the broader category of urinary bladder adenocarcinoma

rejected.label: Primary adenocarcinoma of the bladder
rejected.why: This is a less specific term compared to urinary bladder adenocarcinoma, which better captures the nature of the tumor

rejected.label: Signet-Ring Cell Adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Although signet-ring cells are present, the tumor's characteristics are more comprehensively described by urinary bladder adenocarcinoma
